desc: In arbitrary units (arbitrary). The contrast of these images is mainly determined by spatial variations in the spin density (1H) of the imaged specimen. This contrast is achieved at short echo times and long repetition times; for gradient echo, this weighting is also possible with a short TR (TR<<T1) and a small flip angle. Exactly one of: .nii.gz or .nii; .ome.zarr must be present.
